'''Bryan West''' (also published as '''Brian West''')<ref name="dt-19422">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19422 Revenge of the 24 Nerds NO R3], DeckTech (Bryan "Da_StRiKe" West, 21 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19422/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19422/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017005733/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19422/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Da_StRiKe''') posted a [[Dark]] [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind Of Scum]] list on DeckTech in October 2001. As Brian West he played the Nal Hutta Regionals of the [[2021 Regional Championships]] and [[2022 Regional Championships]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-06-2022-regional-championship-events/ 2022 Regional Championships], starwarsccg.org</ref>
